FLASHCARD SET · AGES 4–5

Family & friends — the parent shelf: 35 cards to download and print.

The whole family deck for printing at home: thirty-five family-and-friends cards for ages four to five, each with its who-they-are line, its three pills — age, subject, level — its download button and one-tap printing; the library is the parents’ side of the class, so everything happens on this one shelf.

This is the parents’ copy of Class 45 · Family & Friends: all thirty-five family-and-friends cards on one shelf, ready to print. You do not need a plan — pick the person your child is asking about, download the card, and print it full size on A4 or Letter paper. Every card carries one who-they-are line underneath and four pills on top: the age it suits, the subject it teaches, the grade level to start at, and the skill it builds. The download button takes the full-resolution JPG; the print button runs a single card through your printer with nothing else on the page. There are no card pages to hop through: the shelf is the whole set.

The shelf is yours; the lesson is your child’s. The class page at Family & Friends teaches each person the way a teacher would — spoken to your child, the word said out loud, one tiny way to make their day today — while this wall simply holds the deck for printing. Same thirty-five cards, two jobs: the lesson lives in the class, the library is where parents print.

THE THREE LEVELS

Preschool, Grade 1, Grade 2.

Every card wears a level pill so tonight’s card takes one glance to choose. The levels are a suggested order, not a test — the person your child is asking about is always the right card.

  1. 01

    Preschool · Name it

    the eight words to start with — mum, dad, baby, sister, brother, grandma, grandpa and friend — the people a four-year-old names every day.

  2. 02

    Grade 1 · Do it

    the twelve doing words — son, daughter, twin, sibling, family, parents, children, cousin, aunt, uncle, best friend and neighbour — each one ready for a sentence about your own house.

  3. 03

    Grade 2 · Own it

    the fifteen bigger words — grandchild, nephew, niece, husband, wife, partner, girlfriend, boyfriend, the in-laws, classmate, colleague, roommate, teacher and team — the roles that grow with the family tree.

THE PEOPLE IN MY HOUSE SHELF · 10 CARDS

The people in my house — the ones you wake up next to.

Printable family member flashcards for preschool and up: mum, dad, son, daughter, sister, brother, baby, twin, sibling and the word that holds them all — family. The first people words kids name every single day, one card each with a way to make their day. Download takes the full-resolution JPG; Print runs just that one card through the printer.

THE BIGGER FAMILY SHELF · 10 CARDS

The bigger family — the whole tree, one branch at a time.

Family flashcards for ages 4–5 that grow the family tree: grandma and grandpa, aunt and uncle, cousin, nephew and niece, grandchild, parents and children — the people who fill the holidays and the photo albums. Download takes the full-resolution JPG; Print runs just that one card through the printer.

THE MARRIED-IN & PARTNERS SHELF · 7 CARDS

The married-in family and the partners.

Husband, wife, partner, girlfriend, boyfriend, brother-in-law and sister-in-law — the family members who arrive by wedding and by heart, each on its own printable card with one way to make them feel at home. Download takes the full-resolution JPG; Print runs just that one card through the printer.

THE FRIENDS & NEIGHBORS SHELF · 8 CARDS

The friends and neighbors the family chooses.

Friend and best friend, neighbour, classmate, colleague, roommate, teacher and team — the friends flashcards for the people outside the house who make the day warmer, one printable card each. Download takes the full-resolution JPG; Print runs just that one card through the printer.
